**Goal:** match a biological question to a library type.

## Exercises

- **Q1** You want to quantify mRNA in a degraded FFPE tissue sample. Poly(A) selection or rRNA depletion? Why?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Hint
Where on the transcript does poly(A) capture grab, and what happens to it if the RNA is fragmented?
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Solution
rRNA depletion. Poly(A) capture only recovers the 3' fragment of a degraded transcript, so coverage becomes strongly 3'-biased. rRNA depletion keeps fragments from along the whole transcript.
:::
